title: Why Online Shopping Keeps Closing Down Stores
hook: Your last package closed a store somewhere.
closing: Free shipping isn't free. Somebody's storefront is paying for it.
question: Do you shop online or in person more?

segments.say: Online shopping now makes up 16.4 percent of all retail sales nationwide.
Amazon Prime has grown to 180 million US members, free two-day shipping driving the shift.
4,913 stores closed in 2023. In 2024 that jumped sharply higher.
